text_en: In those days a decree went out from Emperor Augustus that all the world should be registered.
text_cn: 那时凯撒奥古斯都出了一道上谕，叫天下的人都要登记：

text_en: This was the first registration and was taken while Quirinius was governor of Syria.
text_cn: 这是在季黎诺作叙利亚总督时，初次行的登记。

text_en: All went to their own towns to be registered.
text_cn: 于是，众人各去本城登记。

text_en: Joseph also went from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to the city of David called Bethlehem, because he was descended from the house and family of David.
text_cn: 若瑟因为是达味家族的人，也从加里肋亚纳匝肋城，上犹大名叫白冷的达味城去，

text_en: He went to be registered with Mary, to whom he was engaged and who was expecting a child.
text_cn: 好同自己已怀孕的聘妻玛利亚去登记。

text_en: While they were there, the time came for her to deliver her child.
text_cn: 他们在那里的时候，她分娩的日期满了，

text_en: And she gave birth to her firstborn son and wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a manger, because there was no place for them in the inn.
text_cn: 便生了她的头胎男儿，用襁褓裹起，放在马槽里，因为在客栈中为他们没有地方。

text_en: In that region there were shepherds living in the fields, keeping watch over their flock by night.
text_cn: 在那地区有些牧人露宿，守夜看守羊群。

text_en: Then an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
text_cn: 有上主的一个天使站在他们身边，上主的光耀环照着他们，他们便非常害怕。

text_en: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid; for see—I am bringing you good news of great joy for all the people:
text_cn: 天使向他们说：“不要害怕！看，我给你们报告一个为全民族的大喜讯：

text_en: to you is born this day in the city of David a Savior, who is the Messiah, the Lord.
text_cn: 今天在达味城中，为你们诞生了一位救世者，他是主默西亚。

text_en: This will be a sign for you: you will find a child wrapped in bands of cloth and lying in a manger. ”
text_cn: 这是给你们的记号：你们将要看见一个婴儿，裹着襁褓，躺在马槽里。”

text_en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying,
text_cn: 忽有一大队天军，同那天使一起赞颂天主说：

text_en: “Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace among those whom he favors! ”
text_cn: “天主受享光荣于高天， 主爱的人在世享平安！”

text_en: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go now to Bethlehem and see this thing that has taken place, which the Lord has made known to us. ”
text_cn: 众天使离开他们往天上去了以后，牧人们就彼此说：“我们且往白冷去，看看上主报告给我们所发生的事。”

text_en: So they went with haste and found Mary and Joseph, and the child lying in the manger.
text_cn: 他们急忙去了，找到了玛利亚和若瑟，并那躺在马槽中的婴儿。

text_en: When they saw this, they made known what had been told them about this child;
text_cn: 他们看见以后，就把天使对他们论这小孩所说的事，传扬开了，

text_en: and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds told them.
text_cn: 凡听见的人都惊讶牧人向他们所说的事。

text_en: But Mary treasured all these words and pondered them in her heart.
text_cn: 玛利亚却把这一切事默存在自己心中，反复思想。

text_en: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, as it had been told them.
text_cn: 牧人们为了他们所听见和看见的一切，正如天使向他们说的一样，就光荣赞美天主回去了。

text_en: After eight days had passed, it was time to circumcise the child; and he was called Jesus, the name given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
text_cn: 满了八天，孩子应受割损，遂给他起名叫耶稣，这是他降孕母胎前，由天使所起的。

text_en: When the time came for their purification according to the law of Moses, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord
text_cn: 按梅瑟的法律，一满了他们取洁的日期，他们便带着孩子上耶路撒冷去献给上主，

text_en: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every firstborn male shall be designated as holy to the Lord”),
text_cn: 就如上主的法律上所记载的：‘凡开胎首生的男性，应祝圣于上主。’

text_en: and they offered a sacrifice according to what is stated in the law of the Lord, “a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons. ”
text_cn: 并该照上主法律上所吩咐的，献上祭物：一对斑鸠或两只雏鸽。

text_en: Now there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon; this man was righteous and devout, looking forward to the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit rested on him.
text_cn: 那时，在耶路撒冷有一个人，名叫西默盎。这人正义虔诚，期待着以色列的安慰，而且圣神也在他身上。

text_en: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Messiah.
text_cn: 他曾蒙圣神启示：自己在未看见上主的受傅者以前，决见不到死亡。

text_en: Guided by the Spirit, Simeon came into the temple; and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him what was customary under the law,
text_cn: 他因圣神的感动，进了圣殿；那时，抱着婴孩耶稣的父母正进来，要按着法律的惯例为他行礼。

text_en: Simeon took him in his arms and praised God, saying,
text_cn: 西默盎就双臂接过他来，赞美天主说：

text_en: “Master, now you are dismissing your servant in peace, according to your word;
text_cn: “主啊！现在可照你的话， 放你的仆人平安去了！

text_en: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
text_cn: 因为我亲眼看见了你的救援，

text_en: which you have prepared in the presence of all peoples,
text_cn: 即你在万民之前早准备好的：

text_en: a light for revelation to the Gentiles and for glory to your people Israel. ”
text_cn: 为作启示异邦的光明， 你百姓以色列的荣耀。”

text_en: And the child’s father and mother were amazed at what was being said about him.
text_cn: 他的父亲和母亲就惊异他关于耶稣所说的这些话。

text_en: Then Simeon blessed them and said to his mother Mary, “This child is destined for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be opposed
text_cn: 西默盎祝福了他们，又向他的母亲玛利亚说：“看，这孩子已被立定，为使以色列中许多人跌倒和复起，并成为反对的记号──

text_en: so that the inner thoughts of many will be revealed—and a sword will pierce your own soul too. ”
text_cn: 至于你，要有一把利剑刺透你的心灵──为叫许多人心中的思念显露出来。”

text_en: There was also a prophet, Anna the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was of a great age, having lived with her husband seven years after her marriage,
text_cn: 又有一位女先知亚纳，是阿协尔支派法奴耳的女儿，已上了年纪。她出阁后，与丈夫同居了七年，

text_en: then as a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple but worshiped there with fasting and prayer night and day.
text_cn: 以后就守寡，直到八十四岁。她斋戒祈祷，昼夜事奉天主，总不离开圣殿。

text_en: At that moment she came, and began to praise God and to speak about the child to all who were looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 正在那时刻，她也前来称谢天主，并向一切希望耶路撒冷得救赎的人，讲论这孩子。

text_en: When they had finished everything required by the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.
text_cn: 他们按着上主的法律，行完了一切，便返回了加里肋亚，他们的本城纳匝肋。

text_en: The child grew and became strong, filled with wisdom; and the favor of God was upon him.
text_cn: 孩子渐渐长大而强壮，充满智慧，天主的恩宠常在他身上。

text_en: Now every year his parents went to Jerusalem for the festival of the Passover.
text_cn: 他的父母每年逾越节往耶路撒冷去。

text_en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up as usual for the festival.
text_cn: 他到了十二岁时，他们又照节日的惯例上去了。

text_en: When the festival was ended and they started to return, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but his parents did not know it.
text_cn: 过完了节日，他们回去的时候，孩童耶稣却留在耶路撒冷，他的父母并未发觉。

text_en: Assuming that he was in the group of travelers, they went a day’s journey. Then they started to look for him among their relatives and friends.
text_cn: 他们只以为他在同行的人中间，遂走了一天的路程；以后，就在亲戚和相识的人中寻找他。

text_en: When they did not find him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for him.
text_cn: 既找不着，便折回耶路撒冷找他。

text_en: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
text_cn: 过了三天，才在圣殿里找到了他。他正坐在经师中，聆听他们，也询问他们。

text_en: And all who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
text_cn: 凡听见他的人，对他的智慧和对答，都惊奇不止。

text_en: When his parents saw him they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Child, why have you treated us like this? Look, your father and I have been searching for you in great anxiety. ”
text_cn: 他们一看见他，便大为惊异，他的母亲就向他说：“孩子，为什么你这样对待我们？看，你的父亲和我，一直痛苦的找你。”

text_en: He said to them, “Why were you searching for me? Did you not know that I must be in my Father’s house? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们为什么寻找我？你们不知道我必须在我父亲那里吗？”

text_en: But they did not understand what he said to them.
text_cn: 但是，他们不明白他对他们所说的话。

text_en: Then he went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was obedient to them. His mother treasured all these things in her heart.
text_cn: 他就同他们下去，来到纳匝肋，属他们管辖。他的母亲把这一切默存在心中。

text_en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and in years, and in divine and human favor.
text_cn: 耶稣在智慧和身量上，并在天主和人前的恩爱上，渐渐地增长。
